title: Pi: all subagent runs share session ID `session`, so checkpoints capture the wrong transcript

worker.report:
I added a test, and it passes with the fix. I didn't run it against the unfixed code first, so I haven't seen it fail. The narrow run also covered the existing `TestExtractSessionIDFromPath`, which still passes.

`extractSessionIDFromPath` now gives each subagent run its own ID, `<parentUUID>-<subagent>-<run>`. Before, every run's transcript was named `session.jsonl` and resolved to `session`. This is your option 2 (a separate ID per run), not option 1. It doesn't populate `SubagentID` or change `entire_extension.ts`, so the subagent runs will still appear as their own session rows.

The test builds three subagent paths and checks that none resolves to `session` and that all three IDs differ.

Test name: `TestExtractSessionIDFromPath_SubagentRunsAreDistinct`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/agent/pi/lifecycle.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/agent/pi/subagent_session_id_test.go` (new)
